items.abstract:
<jats:p>We present a local, lightweight SQL Agent for giving business analysts natural language access to  structured databases. It is built with open-source technologies: LangChain, DuckDB, and  LLaMA3 through Ollama - this project allows analysts to communicate in plain English and  receive related SQL queries and result sets without coding. The project includes a simplified  Streamlit UI, schema-based prompt generation, interactive error management by editing  queries, and out-puts of both SQL queries and results datasets in CSV format.  Unlike cloud offerings, everything runs fully on a local machine thus ensuring privacy, faster  service, and complete control of data workflows. We describe the various pieces of the  architecture, including a DuckDB backend, local LLM-based query generation, and session-state  logic to persist and recover from faults. The agent saves questions asked by the user and the  execution state of those questions for further insight into debugging and improvement.  We demonstrate the usability of this tool for top-N queries, joins, and filters across customer  and sales data sets as defined by the Chinook schema. The paper describes future enrichments  such as, live MySQL/PostgreSQL connections, role-based access to data, and REST API  extensions.  Our goal is to show how a local LLM agent could simplify data access for non-technical users,  with complete transparency, trust, and control of the system. This agent could be a staring  point for organizations looking to modernize how they provide access to analytics using GenAI  while maintaining overall security and governance.</jats:p>
                <jats:p>
                  The complete implementation accompanying this preprint is archived at Zenodo:
                  <jats:ext-link xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xlink:href="https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17581843">https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17581843</jats:ext-link>
                </jats:p>
title: A Lightweight Local SQL Agent Using LLMs and DuckDB for Business Analytics
